description: A React component class 'Block' for rendering curriculum blocks in the FreeCodeCamp platform, including various layouts and interactions, with Redux state management and internationalization.

classes.name: Block
classes.description: React component class for rendering curriculum blocks with multiple layout options, handling user interactions, and connecting to Redux store.

methods.name: handleBlockClick
methods.description: Plays a tone and toggles the expansion state of the block.

methods.name: handleChallengeClick
methods.description: Updates browser history with the challenge/dashed block URL fragment.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the block component with various layout options based on props and state.
